patterns.note: Alternating full-width sections with high-contrast dark backgrounds and light backgrounds, creating clear visual breaks and defining content areas.
Extensive use of grid layouts for feature showcases, portfolio examples, and testimonials, maintaining visual consistency across diverse content types.
Large, bold sans-serif headings are used for section titles and hero text, establishing a strong visual hierarchy against smaller, highly legible body text.

A high-contrast monochrome palette of black, dark gray, light gray, and white is dominant, with vibrant colors introduced primarily through embedded product UI elements and diverse portfolio examples.
Sections and content blocks reveal with a subtle fade-up or slide-in effect as they enter the viewport during scrolling, creating a dynamic content flow.
Feature sections are presented as two-column grids of cards, each with a concise heading, description, and a 'Learn more' call-to-action, often accompanied by a product UI screenshot.
A large, immersive portfolio grid showcases numerous website examples, culminating in a distinctive, dynamic angled grid layout in the 'Spark your start' section.

technique_notes: Sections are revealed using a scroll-triggered animation system, where content blocks subtly fade up or slide into view as the user scrolls down the page. The detected Lottie tech may be used for specific, more complex animations within these sections.
The primary navigation bar remains fixed at the top of the viewport, providing persistent access to site navigation throughout the user's journey.
Product UI screenshots and website previews are integrated directly into feature cards and full-bleed sections, often presented with a subtle shadow to give them depth and visual prominence.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, bold sans-serif hero text (~4-5x body) with clear hierarchy down to smaller, legible body text and uppercase labels.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounded corners (small radius) are consistently applied to cards, buttons, and image containers, providing a soft, modern feel.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced density overall, with generous vertical spacing between major sections and within the hero, but a denser grid for portfolio showcases.

standout: The site's distinctive design lies in its immersive integration of the product's visual output and UI directly into the marketing narrative. The dynamic, angled grid of website previews in the 'Spark your start' section is particularly effective at visually demonstrating the product's capabilities rather than just describing them.
